top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete and independently confirmed discovery chain: proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, glucose-dependent insulin secretion, and central and gastric effects. Large outcome trials now show glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit, so maturity is not in doubt. Holst (secretion physiology), Drucker (mechanism and translational proof of concept) and Mojsov (identification and synthesis of the active peptide) cover the discovery side. A citation worded around physiology and active forms does not claim the drug-design step. The attribution weaknesses (Mojsov versus Habener's group, Knudsen excluded) are real but smaller than no award for an achievement of this strength.
